nat_damage_multiplier: Attacks have a {chance} chance to raise that strike's damage to {mult}{link}.
nat_execution: When enemy HP is below {threshold}, attacks have a {chance} chance to raise damage to {mult}{link}.
nat_lifesteal: Converts {value} of every hit's damage into HP.
nat_poison: Attacks have a {chance} chance to poison the enemy: {damage} damage per action, for {turns} actions{link}.
nat_stun: Attacks have a {chance} chance to stun the enemy for 1 action{link}.
nat_extra_strikes: Attacks have a {chance} chance to follow up with a strike at {extra} damage{link}.
nat_damage_reduction: Every hit taken is reduced by {value}.
nat_reflect: Reflects {value} of every hit taken back at the attacker.
nat_heal: At the start of an action, {chance} chance to recover {value} HP.
nat_low_hp_atk_bonus: Once HP falls below {threshold}, ATK +{value} for the rest of the fight.
nat_streak_bonus: Consecutive hits each add +{value} damage per stack (max {cap} stacks); a miss resets the streak{link}.
nat_overload: Every attack costs {cost} of max HP as fuel, raising that strike's damage to {mult}{link}.
nat_armor_shred: Attacks have a {chance} chance to shatter armor: DEF −{value} for {turns} actions, stacking up to {max_stacks} times{link}.
nat_bleed: Attacks have a {chance} chance to cause bleeding: {value} of the attacker's ATK as damage per action, for {turns} actions{link}.
nat_exploit: While the enemy is debuffed (stunned/poisoned/bleeding/shredded) or about to act, damage is increased by {value}{link}.
nat_gauge_surge: Every landed hit advances the action gauge by an extra {value}%.
nat_gamble: Every attack has a {chance} chance to raise damage to {mult}, otherwise damage drops to {penalty}{link}.
nat_bulwark: While own HP is at least {threshold}, damage taken is reduced by {value}.
nat_retribution: Each critical hit taken grants +{value} crit, stacking up to {cap} times.
nat_iron_will: Once per battle: survive a fatal blow with 1 HP left.
nat_cleanse: At the start of an action, {chance} chance to cleanse poison and bleeding and recover {value} HP.
nat_armor_pen: Attacks ignore {value} of the enemy's DEF.
nat_blood_pact: At battle start, sacrifice {cost} of max HP for a permanent +{value} ATK.
nat_grudge: Each hit taken grants 1 grudge stack: +{value} damage per stack (max {cap} stacks).
